meta.evidence_status: SIMULATION (pencil model P1, synthetic handwriting and synthetic tremor; nothing measured)

protocol.reference: same pen, NEUTRAL, same handwriting without tremor (harness convention)
protocol.ratio: e_rms(controller)/e_rms(NEUTRAL with tremor), both against the reference
protocol.band_ratio: same with the 3-15 Hz band of the ink error (sim/pencil/evaluate.py)
protocol.oracle_band: true disturbance band-passed 3-15 Hz zero-phase, injected as an external estimate (NOT causal): the best any tremor-band estimator can do
protocol.external: causal estimate from sensor streams generated on the NEUTRAL run's recorded housing motion, injected with M.with_estimate, Controller(mode='external')
protocol.housing_vs_neutral_rms_um: RMS difference between the controlled run's housing path and the neutral run's (the approximation of the external pattern)
protocol.distortion: the estimator on the tremor-free writing against the reference
protocol.grid: scenarios.handwriting(seed, duration=5.0, tremor=TremorSpec(f0, amp_pk), N0=1.0), PencilConfig() defaults, q_lim 0.30 mm
protocol.sensors: page sensor 1 kHz / 2 ms / 3 um (P1 default) or 120 Hz / 10 ms / 3 um (proposed requirement); LSM6DSV16X-class IMU 60 ug/sqrt(Hz) at 3.84 kHz, 0.35 ms after the recorded 1.04 ms filter, gyroscope-compensated; pen rotation rho_t = rho_w = 0.5 (ASSUMPTION)
protocol.residual_ratio: open-loop RMS(d - d_hat)/RMS(d) at the ticks in contact (signal level)
protocol.intent_err_um: time-aligned RMS distance of the ink from the intended hand path (scenario.intended), static offset removed; not a harness metric
protocol.path_um: nearest-point (timing-free) RMS distance of the ink from the intended hand path

akf_personal.note: personal set calibrated on each writer's 6 and 10 Hz / 0.3 mm calibration task, then run on that seed's tremor-free writing
